purpose: Measure a saturated full straight belt and retain lane-specific source/collector counts.

entities: two counted lane collectors before removal
setup.supply_conditions: Iron plates are available on both lanes, each up to 15 items/s; each source extraction is counted.
setup.removal_conditions: Each collector count is recorded before the chest is emptied; no delete sink is used for the measurement.

power_control.circuit_state: no circuit wires or enable condition

expected_not_observed: The documented full-belt reference is 30 items/s. The harness must record both lane counts rather than infer them from a screenshot.
